tour.defi.list.title: What your addresses hold
tour.defi.list.body: Pools, loans and staking of the followed addresses. The app only reads them from the network: a position cannot be added or edited here.
tour.defi.net.title: A dash is not zero
tour.defi.net.body: The net result is what the position earned beyond what was put in. A dash means «nobody knows this figure» (no token price or no history), never a zero. The ≈ mark means the adapter itself called the number approximate.
tour.defi.fees.title: Fees and accruals
tour.defi.fees.body: A pool has fees, a loan or staking has accruals, and they are already inside the value. Loss against holding is shown for reference and is not part of the net.
cryptoTrack.positions.hint.putIn: What the position cost on the day it was put in: at the deposit-day price, not today's.
cryptoTrack.positions.hint.value: What the position is worth now, at current token prices. The result is a figure of its own: it also counts fees, gas and withdrawals.
whatsNew.cryptoPositions.title: DeFi positions
whatsNew.cryptoPositions.screen: A new «DeFi positions» screen: pools, loans and staking of your addresses, amount put in and current value, net result, fees and accruals. The data is only read from the network.
whatsNew.cryptoPositions.unknown: A dash means «the figure is unknown», never a zero; the ≈ mark means the adapter called the number approximate. Loss against holding is shown for reference and is not part of the net.
